$comment: MA-008. Everything the report treats as a fact about our own accounts, editable without touching code. Prices marked assumed are not read from an API and must be checked against the invoice.

vercel.$comment: teamCapUsd is the spend-management cap the operator set ($300 since 2026-09-21, $200 before); the cycle and the on-demand dollars come from `vercel usage`, which is the same source as the dashboard.

neon.$comment: Pricing is assumed from the Launch plan page; the API on this plan exposes month-to-date usage, not dollars. Labels say what READS each project; a project with no reader here is not unused, it is unknown, and is never to be deleted on the strength of this report.

labels.lingering-sea-07597558: inspectionly.ca PRODUCTION database (Vercel Marketplace integration, not Miltonly's, never touch)

analytics.$comment: MA-011: Web Analytics is read through the Vercel Query API (/v1/query/web-analytics/visits/count and /aggregate), live since 2026-09-22. The API groups referrers by hostname, so an entry with a path (bing.com/chat, search.brave.com/ai) cannot be told from its search engine and is not matched.

sampleFloor.$comment: rateDenominator: a rate is not printed under this many in the denominator. countForTrend: a day-over-day or week-over-week claim needs both sides at or above this.

runnerCost.$comment: GitHub-hosted ubuntu minutes on a private repository, beyond the free 2,000 a month.
